title: Jackson Ward, 1952 (proof of the traced Sanborn layer; not for publication)
about: Proof only: buildings standing today dated as in the streetcars series, plus buildings traced from the Sanborn 1925 volume 3 as republished in 1951-52 (history/sanborn/jackson-ward-lost.geojson). The ground is today's lidar, so the 1958 highway cut shows under the 1952 buildings.
